purpose: Verify an authorized user can access the course workspace and view course home information including syllabus, schedule, instructors, and TAs.
preconditions: Course exists; user is enrolled/assigned as student, faculty, TA, or observer.
action_or_input: Authorized user requests course workspace details for the enrolled course.
expected_result: Access granted; course workspace details with syllabus, schedule, and rosters are returned.

purpose: Verify that course access is denied when the requesting user is not authorized or not enrolled in the selected course.
preconditions: Course exists; requesting user has no enrollment or assignment in the course.
action_or_input: Unenrolled user attempts to access course workspace details.
expected_result: Access is denied or returns None, preventing workspace exposure.

purpose: Verify that when registration/link data are missing or unavailable, the system does not expose workspace content.
preconditions: User exists but has no registration record in the course.
action_or_input: User queries workspace details for an unlinked course.
expected_result: Workspace data is not exposed; access confirmation fails.

purpose: Verify assigned faculty can configure and update course workspace details.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to the course.
action_or_input: Assigned faculty updates course syllabus, schedule, and description.
expected_result: Course details are successfully updated and reflected in course workspace.

purpose: Verify assigned faculty can edit previously published course details.
preconditions: Course details have previously been published; faculty is assigned.
action_or_input: Faculty edits existing syllabus and schedule with updated text.
expected_result: Updated course details overwrite previous values and are saved successfully.

purpose: Verify that an unauthorized user or faculty not assigned to the course cannot update course details.
preconditions: User is not assigned faculty for the course (e.g. unassigned faculty or student).
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to update course details.
expected_result: Action is rejected with permission/authorization error.

purpose: Verify assigned faculty can add course material (file, link, or note) with immediate publication.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to the course.
action_or_input: Faculty adds a material in a module section with status published.
expected_result: Material is saved and marked published immediately.

purpose: Verify assigned faculty can add course material scheduled for future release.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to the course.
action_or_input: Faculty adds material with future release date/time and scheduled status.
expected_result: Material is saved and marked Scheduled.

purpose: Verify assigned faculty can edit or reorganize existing course material.
preconditions: Course material exists in the course; faculty is assigned.
action_or_input: Faculty updates material title, section, or content.
expected_result: Material configuration is updated successfully.

purpose: Verify that student, TA, or observer attempts to add or manage course materials are rejected.
preconditions: User is enrolled as student, TA, or observer (not faculty).
action_or_input: Non-faculty user attempts to add course material.
expected_result: Write attempt is rejected with permission error.

purpose: Verify authorized course user (Student, TA, Observer) can view published course materials in read-only form.
preconditions: User has course access; material is published.
action_or_input: Authorized user requests course materials.
expected_result: Published materials are listed and readable.

purpose: Verify scheduled or unpublished course material is omitted from student view until released.
preconditions: Course has materials in scheduled or draft status; student is enrolled.
action_or_input: Student lists course materials.
expected_result: Scheduled and draft materials are not included in student view.

purpose: Verify that unauthorized course access to course materials is denied.
preconditions: User is not enrolled in the course.
action_or_input: Unenrolled user attempts to list course materials.
expected_result: Access is denied or returns None, preventing material exposure.

purpose: Verify assigned faculty can post a course-wide announcement with timestamp.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to the course.
action_or_input: Faculty submits a new announcement with title and content.
expected_result: Announcement is stored with timestamp and made visible course-wide.

purpose: Verify permitted TA can post a course-wide announcement when permitted.
preconditions: TA is assigned to course with announcement permission.
action_or_input: Permitted TA submits a new announcement.
expected_result: Announcement is saved and visible course-wide.

purpose: Verify unauthorized user (e.g. Student or unpermitted user) cannot post announcements.
preconditions: User is enrolled as student or is not a permitted poster.
action_or_input: Student attempts to post a course announcement.
expected_result: Posting is rejected with authorization/permission error.

purpose: Verify authorized course users can view timestamped course announcements.
preconditions: Course has announcements; user is enrolled.
action_or_input: Authorized user requests course announcements.
expected_result: Announcements list is returned with timestamps and content.

purpose: Verify unauthorized user cannot view course announcements.
preconditions: User is not enrolled in the course.
action_or_input: Unenrolled user attempts to view course announcements.
expected_result: Access is denied or returns empty/None, protecting announcement content.

purpose: Verify assigned faculty can create a new assignment in Draft state with due date, instructions, submission type, and points.
preconditions: Faculty is assigned to the course.
action_or_input: Faculty creates assignment with required parameters.
expected_result: Assignment is created and stored in Draft state.

purpose: Verify assigned faculty can edit an existing Draft assignment configuration.
preconditions: Assignment exists in Draft state; faculty is assigned.
action_or_input: Faculty modifies instructions, points possible, or due date of draft assignment.
expected_result: Assignment details are updated and remain in Draft state.

purpose: Verify TA, student, or observer cannot create or edit assignments.
preconditions: User is enrolled as TA, student, or observer.
action_or_input: Non-faculty user attempts to create or edit an assignment.
expected_result: Operation is rejected with permission error.

purpose: Verify assigned faculty can publish a valid Draft assignment for immediate availability.
preconditions: Assignment is in Draft state with valid configuration (instructions, future due date, points).
action_or_input: Faculty publishes the assignment without future release date.
expected_result: Assignment transitions to Published state and becomes Available to students.

purpose: Verify assigned faculty can publish an assignment scheduled for future release.
preconditions: Assignment is Draft with valid configuration and future release date.
action_or_input: Faculty publishes assignment configured with future release date.
expected_result: Assignment is marked Published/Scheduled for Release, waiting for scheduled release time.

purpose: Verify that an invalid Draft assignment cannot be published.
preconditions: Draft assignment lacks required fields (e.g. invalid/missing due date or empty title/instructions).
action_or_input: Faculty attempts to publish invalid Draft assignment.
expected_result: Publication fails with validation rule error; assignment remains Draft.

purpose: Verify registered student can view and download published available assignment details.
preconditions: Assignment is published and available; student is registered in course.
action_or_input: Student retrieves assignment details.
expected_result: Assignment details, instructions, due date, and points are visible.

purpose: Verify draft or future-dated unreleased assignments are omitted from student view.
preconditions: Assignment is Draft or Scheduled for future release; student is registered.
action_or_input: Student queries available assignments in course.
expected_result: Unreleased assignment is not visible in student list.

purpose: Verify unauthorized user (not registered in course) cannot view assignment.
preconditions: User is not registered in the course.
action_or_input: Unenrolled user attempts to view assignment details.
expected_result: Access is denied or returns None.

purpose: Verify registered student can submit on-time assignment work matching configured submission type.
preconditions: Assignment is published/available; current time is before due date; student is registered.
action_or_input: Student submits work matching configured submission type.
expected_result: Submission is recorded with timestamp and valid status.

purpose: Verify submission handling when submission occurs after due date (late submission).
preconditions: Assignment is published; due date has passed; student is registered.
action_or_input: Student submits work after due date.
expected_result: System marks submission status as late or applies policy validation.

purpose: Verify submission with type inconsistent with assignment configuration is rejected.
preconditions: Assignment requires file upload; student is registered.
action_or_input: Student attempts submission with mismatched type (e.g. text/link when file required or empty content).
expected_result: Submission is rejected with validation error.

purpose: Verify registered student can view their own assignment submission history and status.
preconditions: Student has submitted an assignment.
action_or_input: Student requests own submission history for the assignment.
expected_result: Own submission record, timestamp, and status are returned.

purpose: Verify submission status reflects appropriate status (submitted, late, or missing).
preconditions: Student has not submitted an assignment and due date is past, or submitted late.
action_or_input: Student checks status for the assignment.
expected_result: System reports accurate submission status (late, submitted, or missing).

purpose: Verify access to another student submission data is denied.
preconditions: Two students are registered; student A has submitted work.
action_or_input: Student B attempts to view Student A submission details.
expected_result: Access is denied or returns None, protecting student privacy.

purpose: Verify faculty or TA can grade a student submission, recording points, feedback, and grader attribution in Draft state.
preconditions: Submission exists; grader is faculty or TA for course.
action_or_input: Grader enters valid points and feedback for submission.
expected_result: Grade is recorded in Draft state with grader attribution and timestamp.

purpose: Verify that regrading or editing an already graded submission records an updated grade with audit tracking.
preconditions: Submission has already been graded; grader is assigned faculty.
action_or_input: Faculty updates points and feedback on previously graded submission.
expected_result: Updated grade is recorded with updated timestamp and grader attribution.

purpose: Verify unauthorized user (e.g. Student or observer) cannot grade submissions.
preconditions: Submission exists; actor is student or observer.
action_or_input: Unauthorized user attempts to submit a grade.
expected_result: Grading action is rejected with permission error.

purpose: Verify assigned faculty can release draft grades and feedback to students.
preconditions: Draft grades exist for assignment; actor is assigned faculty.
action_or_input: Faculty releases grades for the assignment.
expected_result: Grades transition from Draft to Released and become available to students.

purpose: Verify TA or unauthorized user cannot release grades.
preconditions: Draft grades exist; actor is TA or student.
action_or_input: TA attempts to release grades.
expected_result: Release action is rejected with permission error.

purpose: Verify registered student can view their own released grade and feedback in read-only form.
preconditions: Grade has been released for the student.
action_or_input: Student queries grade for the assignment.
expected_result: Student views points, feedback, and released status.

purpose: Verify unreleased draft grade is not exposed to student.
preconditions: Submission has been graded by faculty but grade is still in Draft state (unreleased).
action_or_input: Student queries grade for the assignment.
expected_result: Grade is not exposed (returns None or empty), preserving draft confidentiality.

purpose: Verify scheduled content (material or assignment) whose release time has passed is transitioned to Published/Available.
preconditions: Content exists in Scheduled state with release time in the past.
action_or_input: Scheduled content release processor is executed.
expected_result: Eligible scheduled content transitions to Published state and becomes visible.
